Compare iPhone 16, Pixel 9 and Galaxy S25 side by side and highlight the best value
7:15 PM

The Galaxy S25 is the best value on specs: it is the only one with a 3x zoom camera and a 120Hz screen, and it has the fastest chip. Launch prices were within about ₹1,100 of each other, so features decide it. These are specs from memory, and today's prices vary by seller and offers, so I can check them if you want.
